renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Sit inside one long ringing tone, mind in one piece — and at the far end of it your body turns sky-body. Or run the body-prayer through its rough course down to the moon-drop sound — then speak from the open, and be Śiva.

Feel your own body as all directions at once, like sky — mind with no direction, and sky pours through it. Or picture the open behind you and the open at your root together — drop the body out of mind, and turn open-minded.

Hold the back-open, root-open, and heart-open steady all at once — out of thoughtlessness the thoughtless rising comes. Even one blink of openness is enough: thought-free, thought-free, sharing the thought-free way of being.

Let the body-stuff melt till only sky is left filling you — then your seeing grows steady. Think through the skin like a wall and find nothing inside — you become one who shares in the unthought. Rest in the heart's lotus-box, undivided — and the greatest good fortune is won.
From all around your body, at the twelve-end, let mind melt — hold firm, and the mark of the real grows firm.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: One long tone, mind single-file — at the limit your body goes sky-body. Or run the body-chant down its rough road to the moon-drop sound — then talk from the open and turn Śiva.
Wear your body as every direction at once, sky-style — mind with no compass and sky runs all the way through. Or hold back-open plus root-open at the same time — body off the mind, mind gone open.
Pin back-open, root-open, heart-open, all three, steady — thoughtlessness births the thoughtless rise. A blink of open is plenty: blank, blank, blank all the way down.

Melt the body-stuff till sky is all that's left of you — then your seeing locks in. Think through the skin-wall and find zero inside — shareholder of the unthought. Park in the heart's lotus-box, undivided — greatest fortune, claimed.
All around the body to the twelve-end, dissolve the mind — lock in hard and the realness-mark sets.
